text.content: Enter the rated shunt current and voltage (mV) in the input fields above.
text.desc: Message text to prompt the user to enter in the shunt's electrical characteristics before starting the calibration routine.

text.content: Using a multimeter, measure the voltage (mV) across the shunt and enter it in the input field above.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to use a multimeter to enter the voltage measured across the shunt. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Using a multimeter, measure the voltage from the torch's electrode to the work piece and enter it in the input field above.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to measure the voltage between the weld head's torch and the work piece using a multimeter. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Connect the variable power supply across the electrode and the work piece.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to connect an external power supply to the system for use in a calibration procedure.

text.content: Set the output of the variable power supply to be between 5 - 6 Volts.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to adjust the external power supply's output to be between 5 - 6V. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Set the output of the variable power supply to be between 25 - 30 Volts.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to adjust the external power supply's output to be between 25 - 30V. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: The load bank's resistance settings should be selected to create a voltage in the arc welding range.
text.desc: A prompt for the user to adjust their load bank settings to achieve a suitable initial voltage. This is preparation for a calibration procedure.

text.content: Before proceeding, connect a calibrated resistive shunt onto the work lead.
text.desc: A prompt for the user to connect a resistive shunt which is a tool used in a calibration procedure. This is preparation for a calibration procedure.

text.content: The power supply may report that the arc could not be started if the initial voltage is too high or too low.
text.desc: A prompt for the user to adjust their load bank settings to achieve a suitable initial voltage. This is preparation for a calibration procedure.

text.content: Have a multimeter ready to measure the current but do not connect the meter until after the power supply is enabled.
text.desc: A prompt for the user to prepare a multimeter measurement device to be used in a calibration procedure.

text.content: Jog the weld head to the desired position to begin calibration.
text.desc: Jog or move the weld head to the desired position. This is preparation for a calibration procedure.

text.content: Please use caution, pressing START will enable the power supply.
text.desc: A warning to the user that pressing start will enable the power supply. This is part of a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Measure the %1 and enter it in the input field above.
text.desc: %1 = parameter being calibrated. Message text prompting the user to physically measure the distance traveled by the axis during calibration.

text.content: Measure the distance between the new limits and enter it in the input field above.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to physically measure the distance between the two limits previously set. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Prepare the weld head and work area to jog the axis to its desired limit.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to prepare the weld head and work space to calibrate its limits. Limit calibration requires the head to be physically positioned to both sides of its limits.

text.content: Jog the selected axis to its %1 limit.
text.desc: %1 = FIRST or SECOND limit. Message text prompting the user to position the axis to record its first limit. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Jog the selected axis to the centre (zero) position.
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to position the weld head's axis in the center of the two previously set limits. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Click NEXT to begin homing the weld head.
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that clicking next will begin moving the axis. Will begin a homing routine. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: Waiting for the weld head to reach its home position...
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that the homing routine is in progress. This is a step of a calibration procedure.

text.content: There is no schedule loaded. Would you like to create or load a schedule?
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to load a schedule (weld program) before navigating into the weld area.

text.desc: Message text notifying the user that there is no components of the system that can be calibrated.

text.content: Units of measure have changed. Do you want to make these changes permanent?
text.desc: Message text asking the user to save changes made to the user units.

text.content: Certain changes made to the settings require a full system restart. Please power down the system.
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that changes that were made to the system require a full restart to go into effect. The user must power down the system to continue.

text.content: Any file that shares a name with an imported file will be overwritten. Do you want to proceed with importing files?
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to confirm importing files. If there is any file already on the system with the same name as a file that is being imported, the file will be overwritten.

text.content: Would you like to delete files after exporting?
text.desc: Message text asking the user if they would like to delete the files from the system after they have been exported to a USB device.

text.content: The update failed. Please view the trace logs for more details.
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that there was a error while attempting to perform an update. The user must view the trace logs to gain additional details as to why the update failed.

text.content: The restore failed. Please view the trace logs for more details.
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that there was a error while attempting to perform a restore. The user must view the trace logs to gain additional details as to why the restore operation failed.

text.content: An update will cause functional changes to the system. Do you want to proceed with the update?
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to confirm updating the application.

text.content: Do you want to delete this user %1 from the system?
text.desc: %1 = User Name. Message text prompting the user to confirm deleting a user from the system.

text.content: System settings have changed. Do you want to make these changes permanent?

text.content: Selected logs have been written to the current trace log file.
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that the selected logs have been written to the trace log file.

text.content: Please be advised, writing to the trace log file can take several minutes to complete.
text.desc: Message text asking user which type of logs to write to the trace log file.

text.content: PID values have changed. Do you want to make these changes permanent?
text.desc: Message text asking the user to save changes made to the PID values.

text.content: User security settings have changed. Do you want to make these changes permanent?
text.desc: Message text asking the user to save changes made to the security settings.

text.content: There have been changes made to the schedule. Do you want to make these changes permanent?
text.desc: Message text asking the user to save changes made to the schedule (weld program).

text.content: There have been changes made to the chainset. Do you want to make these changes permanent?
text.desc: Message text asking the user to save changes made to the chainset.

text.content: Resetting the calibration will cause functional changes to the system. Do you want to proceed with the reset?
text.desc: Message text prompting the user to confirm resetting the calibration values back to their default states.

text.content: Resetting the device will delete all of the stored logs. Do you want to proceed with the reset?
text.desc: Message text warning the user that resetting device settings will erase all stored data and prompting the user to confirm the reset.

text.content: Do you wish to delete this file: %1?
text.desc: %1 = file name. Message text prompting the user to confirm deleting file.

text.content: Do you wish to delete this folder: %1?
text.desc: %1 = folder name. Message text prompting the user to confirm deleting folder.

text.content: There are no event log files to view. Please enable event logs to begin recording events.
text.desc: Message text notifying the user that there are no event log files to view. The user must enable the recording of events before there can be events to view.

text.content: Do you want to log out %1?
text.desc: %1 = name of the user currently logged in. Message prompting the user to confirm logging out the user.

text.content: Please select a groove depth before starting schedule selection.
text.desc: A message prompting the user to select a groove depth in order to schedule selection.

text.content: Please select a diameter before starting schedule selection.
text.desc: A message prompting the user to select a diameter in order to schedule selection.

text.content: A critical software error has occurred. Please wait while a diagnostics file is created...
text.desc: A message prompting the user to restart the system since a critical error has occurred.

text.content: A critical software error has occurred. Please restart the system.
text.desc: A message prompting the user to restart the system since a critical error has occurred.
